Introduction

Wondior is a South Korean rapper and singer known for his vibrant style and genre-blending sound. He officially debuted in May 2022 with the EP "SEE ME UP" under the label 502. He's influenced by genres including trap, R&B, jazz, and even Chamorro music from his upbringing in Guam.
